clue.text: Place and time can be very destructive

clue.text: Pasta as possible anag of Los Angeles?

clue.text: Terribly verbose remark

explanation.definitionFit: To plunder a place is to rob it, carrying off goods by force.

clue.text: First in the field (estimated)

clue.text: Solver starts to think of Salad Days

clue.text: Stink in government terminally spread like wildfire, with your first result of Euro-crisis …

indicators.note: in means the stink word goes between the ends of government
terminally means only the end letters of government are used

a fire or epidemic that raged spread fiercely

indicators.note: first means just the opening letter of your

explanation.surface: A political scandal spreads fast through government, leading to the eurozone crisis.

explanation.definitionFit: The 2012 Greek debt disaster was itself a drama of downfall, punning on the classical genre of plays ending in catastrophe.

clue.text: … some of which I spied, disguised as exponent of 11 28

clue.text: Insult that should not take one aback?

clue.text: Urge former partner to start gardening

clue.text: First among men making work of 27

clue.text: See 11
Nothing can replace extended play for making 4 across horrid

parts.note: O is nothing, a zero

indicators.note: making means the remaining letters are made into a new word
can replace means the record letters come out so that zero can take their place

parts.note: the answer to 4 across, the Theban king
EP is a record format, short for extended play

explanation.definitionFit: Something odious is hateful and repulsive, a stronger word for horrid.
